title: Final Energy Shift
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy shift of the ground state to order E^2.

title: Perturbation Hamiltonian
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and express the perturbation Hamiltonian H' as -qEx.

title: Wave Function Usage
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly utilize the ground state wave function of the harmonic oscillator in their calculations.

title: Second Order Correction
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the second order energy correction method and apply it correctly.

title: Normalization and Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that constants and normalization factors are correctly applied in the calculations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the perturbation terms and energy corrections.

title: Exclusion of n=0
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must correctly exclude the n=0 term in the summation for the second order correction.
